name: Facilitator
text: Facilitator: Once on your turn, as an action, you may take any 1 Player card from a character in your location.

mechanics.effect: Once on your turn, as an action, take any 1 Player card from a character in your location.
restrictions: The character must be in your location
The card taken must be a Player card
mechanics.notes: The production cost is not printed on the sticker. The package manifest lists it as 2 Production Units.
